The decisive mistake was Whitney_Collection_Expert's at Step 9. The team had no link between the photograph and any author. Step 7 had produced only a list of candidates from memory, and the search returned Thomas Morris, a sergeant in the British 73rd Regiment whose book covers 1813 to 1815. Step 9 treated Morris as the working lead and planned to verify his unit from there, which committed the investigation to a candidate that was never tied to the book in accession 2022.128. The correct answer, the Russian-German Legion, was therefore never pursued.
